source: Seeded from mathematics/y11 lesson 72 (Mock section paper (portal, printable; original 4MA1-style questions with a mark scheme): Paper 2H style section, 10 questions, 31 marks)
intro: Mock paper. Answer every question in the spaces provided. Show your working: marks are given for method. The marks for each question are shown in brackets.

questions.q: A length is 8.6 cm and a width 4.2 cm, both to 1 d.p. Find the lower bound of the area.
A machine worth £15,000 depreciates by 18% a year. Find its value after 4 years, to the nearest pound.
Make w the subject of P = (2w + 3)/(w − 1).
Solve 3x² + 5x − 4 = 0, giving your answers to 2 d.p.
f(x) = 2x − 1 and g(x) = x² + 3. (a) Find fg(2). (b) Find f⁻¹(x). (c) Solve gf(x) = 12.
Solve y = x + 2 and y = x² − 4.
A car accelerates uniformly from 6 m/s to 24 m/s in 9 s. Find the acceleration and the distance travelled.
Write x² + 8x + 11 in the form (x + a)² + b and state the minimum value of x² + 8x + 11.
